categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: intelligent manufacturing and integrated services for power equipment, and electric vehicle (EV) charging network business. The power equipment segment focuses on high-voltage prefabricated modular substations and complete switchgear equipment, while the EV charging network segment involves R&D, production, sales, construction, and operation of EV charging infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including 220kV and below intelligent prefabricated modular substations, SF6 gas insulated switchgear (GIS), digitalized high-voltage prefabricated cabin substations, and integrated EV charging network technology with cloud platform management. Manufacturing emphasizes standardization, modularization, digital modeling, and factory assembly to optimize cost and quality. The EV charging products incorporate power sharing, intelligent operation, and vehicle-grid interaction enabled by proprietary cloud platforms and AI-based forecasting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and provincial power grid companies, new energy power generation enterprises (solar, wind, energy storage), railway and urban transit systems, industrial users in sectors like petrochemical, coal mining, data centers, and lithium battery materials. The EV charging business serves public, bus, logistics, industrial park, and residential charging scenarios. The company also targets government entities, state-owned enterprises, and listed companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant projects in provinces such as Shandong, Sichuan, Anhui, Chongqing, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and Yunnan. It also actively expands overseas markets including Central Asia, Southeast Asia, Central and West Africa, and Latin America, participating in infrastructure and renewable energy projects along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao TGOOD Electric is positioned primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment and EV charging supply chains. It designs, manufactures, integrates, and services power distribution equipment and EV charging infrastructure, providing turnkey solutions and operational services to end users and grid operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent manufacturing, digitalization, and integrated services for power equipment, alongside advancing EV charging network technologies including vehicle-grid interaction and virtual power plants. R&D focuses on modular substations, new energy integration, smart low-voltage cabinets, and high-efficiency charging modules using SiC semiconductors. It also invests in energy management platforms and microgrid systems to support carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power equipment and EV charging devices, system integration services, and EV charging network operation services including SaaS platform subscriptions and value-added services. The company also earns income from equipment leasing, engineering contracting, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qingdao TGOOD is a leading player in China's outdoor prefabricated power equipment market, holding the top market share in railway and power sectors. It is the largest EV public charging network operator in China by installed terminals and charging volume, with a market share of approximately 26%. The company is recognized as a technology standard setter and manufacturing champion in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 14.6 billion, a 25.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 491 million, up 80.44%. It maintains a strong asset base of RMB 23.9 billion and continues to grow both its power equipment and EV charging businesses steadily, supported by increasing market demand and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao TGOOD emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, and fast-delivery intelligent power equipment with strong environmental adaptability and digital lifecycle services. Its EV charging network offers integrated, scalable, and intelligent charging solutions with advanced safety features and vehicle-grid interaction capabilities. The company leverages proprietary technology, extensive operational scale, and strategic partnerships to provide reliable, innovative, and customer-centric energy solutions.
